name: cinematic-dual-persona-cultural-identity-arc
description: A luxury video ad pattern that establishes deep cultural identity through two contrasting on-camera personas (female + male) speaking directly to camera in a shared mother tongue, anchored by a contemplative cinematic aesthetic and closed by a brand-voice voiceover end card.
